title: [review] project-LICHEN-worker6-xrvk: cargo fmt violations in std_ext FragmentReceiver
description:
The commit f2ce09c changed rule_id from u8 (0 sentinel) to Option<u8> in the std_ext FragmentReceiver. The logic fix is correct, but cargo fmt --check reports indentation errors across four changed blocks:

1. FragmentReceiver::new() body (line ~1103): struct fields misaligned
2. if let Some(active) = self.rule_id block (line ~1178): inconsistent indentation
3. Ack return block (line ~1232): inconsistent indentation
4. finalize() rule_id extract (line ~1252): inconsistent indentation

Fix: run cargo fmt on the file.
